p: Bell's opportunities remain limited because of the depth in the receiver room.
Three games and no catches. Brady praised his attitude but did not promise a bigger role.
You'd love for him to get some opportunities
Is the next man up at receiver if other WRs can't go.
He is a depth option who could see snaps if Coleman or other WRs are limited.
Skyler is getting all these reps
Bell could be asked to play if Moore or Coleman are out, as he gets reps with the ones in practice.
A deep-league stash/watch if the WR injuries linger, though Brady says his time is still coming.
